description: This source file defines the SystemPresenceInfo enum with static methods to retrieve system presence information, including the last input time in seconds and the primary IPv4 address.

methods.name: lastInputSeconds
methods.description: Returns the number of seconds since the last user input event, or nil if unavailable or invalid.

methods.name: primaryIPv4Address
methods.description: Returns the primary IPv4 address as a string, or nil if not available.
